passages.title: 誠實的計程車司機
passages.text: Last Sunday, Dad took a taxi home from the train station. When he got home, he found that his bag was not with him. He had left it in the taxi! Inside were his computer and some important papers. Dad was so {1} that he could not eat dinner. An hour later, someone knocked on the door. It was the taxi driver! He {2} that he found the bag and saw our address on a letter inside. We later learned that he {3} drove all the way across the city to bring it to us. Dad wanted to give him two thousand dollars, but the driver said no. "I'm just doing the right thing," he said. "Not everyone is as {4} as you," Dad told him. The driver smiled, waved, and {5}.

blanks.why: so worried that…「擔心到…」：爸爸擔心得吃不下晚餐。delicious（好吃的）、modern（現代的）、expensive（貴的）都不能形容人的心情。
explain that…「解釋說…」：司機說明他怎麼找到我們家。allow 要接「人 + to」；fail、mix 都不能接 that 子句。
actually「事實上、其實」：後來才知道他其實開了大老遠來送包包。ago 要接在時間後面；else 要接在 something 等字後面；abroad（在國外）不能放在主詞和動詞之間。
as honest as…「和…一樣誠實」：不是每個人都像你這麼誠實。wet、dry、delicious 都不能用來稱讚還東西的人。
leave「離開」：司機揮揮手就走了。fed（餵）、hunted（打獵）後面要有受詞；landed（降落）不是人離開的動作。

passages.zh: 上星期天，爸爸從火車站搭計程車回家。到家後，他發現包包不在身上——他把包包忘在計程車上了！裡面有他的電腦和一些重要文件。爸爸擔心得連晚餐都吃不下。一個小時後，有人來敲門，竟然是那位計程車司機！他解釋說，他找到了包包，並從裡面一封信上看到我們家的地址。我們後來才知道，他其實是穿越了大半個城市把包包送來的。爸爸想給他兩千元，但司機拒絕了。「我只是做對的事。」他說。「不是每個人都像你這麼誠實。」爸爸對他說。司機笑了笑，揮揮手就離開了。

passages.title: 終於答應的媽媽
passages.text: For two years, I asked Mom for a pet, but she always said no. "Pets need a lot of care," she {1}. "You will get bored after a week." So I made a plan. First, I wrote a list of everything I would do for a pet: feed it, clean its cage, and play with it every day. Then I took care of my cousin's hamster for a whole week. I never {2} to feed it, and I cleaned its cage twice. Mom saw that I was serious. Finally, she {3} me to have a hamster of my own. I named him Bean. Now Bean is my best friend. When I feel sad, I talk to him, and I never feel {4}. Taking care of him has become my favorite {5}.

blanks.why: explain「解釋」：媽媽說明為什麼不能養寵物。allowed、failed、mixed 都不能這樣接在引號後面表示「說」。
never forget to + 原形動詞「從不忘記做…」：從沒忘記餵牠。allow 要接「人 + to」；mix、explain 不能接 to feed。
allow + 人 + to + 原形動詞「允許某人做…」：媽媽終於准我養倉鼠。explain、fail、mix 都不能用「人 + to」的句型。
feel alone「覺得孤單」：跟倉鼠說話就不孤單了。delicious、expensive、modern 都不能形容人的感覺。
favorite hobby「最喜歡的嗜好」：照顧倉鼠成了我的興趣。sentence（句子）、factory（工廠）、distance（距離）都說不通。

passages.zh: 兩年來，我一直跟媽媽要寵物，但她總是說不行。「寵物需要很多照顧，」她解釋，「你一個禮拜後就會膩了。」所以我擬了一個計畫。首先，我列出所有我會為寵物做的事：餵牠、清籠子，還有每天陪牠玩。接著，我幫表哥照顧他的倉鼠整整一個星期。我從來沒忘記餵牠，還清了兩次籠子。媽媽看出我是認真的。最後，她答應讓我養一隻自己的倉鼠。我幫牠取名叫豆豆。現在豆豆是我最好的朋友。我難過的時候會跟牠說話，就再也不覺得孤單了。照顧牠成了我最喜歡的嗜好。

passages.title: 黑掉的生日蛋糕
passages.text: For Mom's birthday, my sister and I decided to bake her a cake. We {1} eggs, sugar, and flour in a big bowl and poured it into a pan. The recipe said to bake it for forty minutes, but we were in a {2} because Mom would be home soon. So we turned the oven up very high. Twenty minutes later, the kitchen was {3} of smoke. Our cake was black on the outside and wet on the inside. We {4}! My sister started to cry. When Mom came home, she saw the black cake and the open windows. We {5} what happened. Mom just laughed and hugged us both. "Thank you. This is the sweetest gift," she said. Then the three of us baked a new cake together, slowly this time.

blanks.why: mix「混合」：把蛋、糖、麵粉混在一起。failed、allowed、explained 都不能用來做蛋糕的步驟。
be in a hurry「趕時間」：媽媽快回來了，所以很趕。in a habit、in a hobby、in a sentence 都不是片語。
be full of smoke「充滿煙」。honest、helpful、alone 都不能接 of smoke 形容廚房。
fail「失敗」：蛋糕烤焦了，我們失敗了。mix、allow、explain 都需要受詞，不能單獨放在句尾。
explain what happened「解釋發生了什麼事」。fail、allow、mix 都不能接 what happened 表示「說明」。

passages.zh: 媽媽生日的時候，我和妹妹決定烤一個蛋糕給她。我們把蛋、糖和麵粉放進大碗裡混合，再倒進烤盤。食譜上說要烤四十分鐘，但我們很趕，因為媽媽快回家了，所以我們把烤箱溫度調得很高。二十分鐘後，廚房裡充滿了煙。我們的蛋糕外面黑掉了，裡面卻還是濕的。我們失敗了！妹妹哭了起來。媽媽回到家，看到黑黑的蛋糕和打開的窗戶。我們向她解釋了發生的事。媽媽只是笑著抱住我們兩個。「謝謝你們，這是最甜蜜的禮物。」她說。然後我們三個人一起重新烤了一個蛋糕，這次慢慢來。

passages.title: 一個人看家
passages.text: Last weekend, my parents went to a wedding in Kaohsiung, and I stayed home {1}. It was the first time they {2} me to do this. At first, I was very happy. I played video games for three hours, ate instant noodles for lunch, and did not do any homework. But at night, the house was very quiet. Suddenly, I heard a strange {3} from the kitchen. My heart beat fast. I picked up a broom and walked slowly into the dark kitchen. I turned on the light. It was {4} just the old refrigerator making noise! I laughed at myself. When my parents came back, I told them everything. "You were brave," Dad said. "Staying home by yourself is not {5}."

blanks.why: stay home alone「一個人在家」。honest（誠實的）、helpful（有幫助的）、full（滿的）都不能說明「在家的狀態」。
allow + 人 + to + 原形動詞「允許某人做…」：第一次准我一個人看家。explain、fail、mix 都不能用「人 + to」的句型。
hear a strange sound「聽到奇怪的聲音」。level（等級）、host（主人）、guess（猜測）都不能「聽到」。
actually「其實」：原來其實只是冰箱的聲音。ago 要接在時間後面；else 要接在 something 等字後面；abroad（在國外）不合語意。
not easy「不容易」：自己看家不簡單。full（滿的）、clear（清楚的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容「自己在家」這件事。

passages.zh: 上個週末，我爸媽去高雄參加婚禮，我一個人留在家裡。這是他們第一次讓我自己看家。一開始我很開心，我打了三個小時的電動，午餐吃泡麵，還一點功課都沒寫。但到了晚上，家裡非常安靜。突然，我聽到廚房傳來奇怪的聲音。我的心跳得好快。我拿起一支掃把，慢慢走進黑漆漆的廚房，打開燈。原來其實只是那台舊冰箱發出的聲音！我自己都笑了出來。爸媽回來後，我把一切都告訴他們。「你很勇敢，」爸爸說，「一個人在家可不容易。」

passages.title: 爸爸教我造句
passages.text: Ms. Lee gave us homework: write a {1} for each new word. One of the words was "honest." I did not know how to use it, so I asked my dad. He {2} it to me with an example. "When I tell your mom her cooking is delicious, I'm being honest," he said. Mom heard this from the kitchen and smiled. Then I wrote my sentence: "My dad is not always {3} about Mom's cooking." The next day, Ms. Lee read it and laughed. She said my sentence was {4} the funniest one in the class. But that evening, Dad saw my homework. His face turned white. He did not {5} me to show it to Mom. I still don't know why.

blanks.why: write a sentence「寫一個句子」：每個新單字造一個句子。hobby（嗜好）、factory（工廠）、habit（習慣）都不能「寫」。
explain + 物 + to + 人「向某人解釋…」：爸爸舉例解釋給我聽。allowed、failed、mixed 都不能用「物 to 人」表示說明。
honest「誠實的」：我的句子說爸爸對媽媽的廚藝不是都說實話，呼應前面的例子。full、wet、dry 都不能接 about Mom's cooking。
actually「事實上、其實」：老師說我的句子其實是全班最好笑的。ago、else、abroad 都不能放在 was 和 the funniest 中間。
allow + 人 + to + 原形動詞「允許某人做…」：爸爸不准我給媽媽看。explain、fail、mix 都不能用「人 + to」的句型。

passages.zh: 李老師出了一份作業：每個新單字都要造一個句子。其中一個單字是「honest（誠實的）」。我不知道怎麼用，所以去問爸爸。他舉了一個例子解釋給我聽。「我跟你媽說她煮的菜很好吃，就是誠實。」他說。媽媽在廚房聽到了，笑了笑。接著我寫下我的句子：「我爸爸對媽媽的廚藝不一定都很誠實。」隔天，李老師看了哈哈大笑。她說我的句子其實是全班最好笑的一句。但那天晚上，爸爸看到了我的作業，臉都白了。他不准我拿給媽媽看。我到現在還是不知道為什麼。

passages.title: 爺爺迷上種多肉
passages.text: After Grandpa stopped working, he did not know what to do every day. He sat on the sofa and watched TV {1} for hours. Grandma was worried. "You need a {2}," she said. So Grandpa started to grow small, thick plants called succulents. He bought ten little pots and {3} sand with soil for them. At first, many of his plants died because he gave them too much water. But he did not give up. He watched videos online and learned more every day. Now he has more than two hundred plants on the roof. He even {4} to the neighbors how to take care of them. He spends so much time on the roof that Grandma laughs and says she {5} sees him in the living room now.

blanks.why: watch TV alone「一個人看電視」。honest、helpful、full 都不能說明看電視的狀態。
need a hobby「需要一個嗜好」：退休後沒事做。sentence（句子）、factory（工廠）、distance（距離）都說不通。
mix A with B「把 A 和 B 混在一起」：把沙和土混合。allowed、failed、explained 都不能用 with 表示混合。
explain to + 人 + how…「向某人解釋怎麼…」：他教鄰居怎麼照顧多肉。allows、fails、mixes 都不能接 to the neighbors how…。
seldom「很少」：奶奶說現在很少在客廳看到他。ago 要接在時間後面；else 要接在 something 等字後面；abroad（在國外）不能放在動詞前面。

passages.zh: 爺爺退休以後，每天都不知道要做什麼。他坐在沙發上，一個人看好幾個小時的電視。奶奶很擔心。「你需要一個嗜好。」她說。於是爺爺開始種一種又小又厚的植物，叫做多肉植物。他買了十個小花盆，把沙子和土混合在一起給它們用。一開始，因為澆太多水，很多植物都死了。但他沒有放棄，他上網看影片，每天學一點新東西。現在他在頂樓有兩百多盆植物，甚至還會跟鄰居解釋怎麼照顧它們。他花太多時間待在頂樓了，奶奶笑著說，現在她很少在客廳看到他。

passages.title: 沒人監考的小考
passages.text: Yesterday, during a math quiz, our teacher, Mr. Wu, got a phone call and had to {1} the classroom. "I will be back in fifteen minutes," he said. "I believe you are all {2} students." After he left, the room was very quiet. Then Jack took out his phone. "Nobody will know," he whispered. His friend Amy shook her head. "That's not fair. Put it away." Jack's face turned red, and he put his phone back in his bag. The next day, Mr. Wu gave back the quizzes. Jack {3} the quiz with a score of fifty, but he was not sad. He told Mr. Wu the whole story. Mr. Wu was very {4} of him. Now Jack studies harder. He says being honest is {5} easier than cheating.

blanks.why: leave the classroom「離開教室」：老師接電話必須離開。allow、explain、mix 接 the classroom 都說不通。
honest students「誠實的學生」：老師相信大家不會作弊。alone 不能放在名詞前面；full students、clear students 都說不通。
fail the quiz「小考不及格」：只考五十分。mixed、allowed、explained 接 the quiz 都不合語意。
be proud of + 人「以某人為榮」：老師為 Jack 的誠實感到驕傲。alone of、full of him、clear of him 都不合語意。
actually「事實上」：誠實其實比作弊容易。ago 要接在時間後面；else 要接在 something 等字後面；abroad 放在這裡不通。

passages.zh: 昨天數學小考時，我們的老師吳老師接到一通電話，必須離開教室。「我十五分鐘後回來，」他說，「我相信你們都是誠實的學生。」他離開後，教室裡非常安靜。這時 Jack 拿出了手機。「沒人會知道的。」他小聲說。他的朋友 Amy 搖搖頭：「這樣不公平，收起來。」Jack 的臉紅了，把手機放回書包裡。隔天，吳老師發回考卷。Jack 考了五十分，沒有及格，但他並不難過。他把整件事告訴了吳老師。吳老師非常以他為榮。現在 Jack 讀書更認真了。他說，誠實其實比作弊還容易。

passages.title: 調出夕陽的顏色
passages.text: In art class, Ms. Chen asked us to paint the sky at sunset. "You can't just use one color," she {1}. "You need to {2} different colors together." First, I mixed red and yellow to make orange. Then I added a little blue, but the color became brown. My sky looked {3}. I almost cried. Ms. Chen came over and said, "Don't worry. Every artist {4} sometimes. That's how we learn." She showed me how to add white to make the colors lighter. I tried again and again. In the end, my sky had five different colors, from pink to deep purple. Ms. Chen liked my painting so much that she put it on the classroom wall. Now painting has become my new {5}, and I paint every weekend.

blanks.why: explain「解釋」：老師說明不能只用一種顏色。allowed、failed、mixed 都不能這樣接在引號後面表示「說」。
mix … together「把…混在一起」：要把不同顏色混合。allow、fail、explain 都不能接 colors together。
look dirty「看起來髒髒的」：顏色變成咖啡色，天空看起來很髒。honest、helpful、alone 都不能形容畫的顏色。
fail「失敗」：每個畫家有時候都會失敗，這就是學習的方法。mixes、allows、explains 都無法安慰人「畫壞了沒關係」。
hobby「嗜好、興趣」：畫畫成了我的新興趣，每週末都畫。sentence（句子）、factory（工廠）、distance（距離）都說不通。

passages.zh: 美術課上，陳老師要我們畫夕陽下的天空。「你們不能只用一種顏色，」她解釋，「你們需要把不同的顏色混在一起。」首先，我把紅色和黃色混成橘色。接著我加了一點藍色，結果顏色變成了咖啡色，我的天空看起來髒髒的。我差點哭出來。陳老師走過來說：「別擔心，每個畫家有時候都會失敗，我們就是這樣學習的。」她教我加白色讓顏色變淺。我試了一次又一次。最後，我的天空有五種不同的顏色，從粉紅色到深紫色。陳老師很喜歡我的畫，還把它貼在教室牆上。現在畫畫成了我的新嗜好，我每個週末都會畫。

passages.title: 熱心的轉學生
passages.text: A new student, Daniel, joined our class this semester. He was very quiet, and for the first two weeks, he always ate lunch {1}. Nobody really talked to him. But soon we found that he was very {2}. When I could not understand a math problem, he {3} it to me step by step. When our classroom printer stopped working, he {4} it in five minutes. He also helped our teacher carry heavy boxes of books. Now everyone likes him. We found out that Daniel is {5} very funny when you get to know him. He can tell jokes in three languages! These days, he never eats lunch by himself. He sits with us, and our table is always the loudest one.

blanks.why: eat lunch alone「一個人吃午餐」：前兩週沒人跟他說話。honest、helpful、full 都不能說明吃飯的狀態。
helpful「樂於助人的、有幫助的」：後面舉了他幫忙的例子。delicious（好吃的）、expensive（貴的）、foreign（外國的）都不符合後面的例子。
explain + 物 + to + 人「向某人解釋…」：一步一步解釋數學題。allowed、failed、mixed 都不能這樣用。
fix「修理」：五分鐘就修好印表機。failed、allowed、mixed 接 it（印表機）都說不通。
actually「其實」：熟了才發現他其實很好笑。ago、else、abroad 都不能放在 is 和 very funny 中間。

passages.zh: 這學期，我們班來了一位新同學 Daniel。他很安靜，前兩個星期，他總是一個人吃午餐，沒有人真的跟他說過話。但很快我們就發現他非常樂於助人。我看不懂一題數學時，他一步一步解釋給我聽。教室的印表機壞掉時，他五分鐘就修好了。他也會幫老師搬很重的書箱。現在大家都很喜歡他。我們發現，熟了之後，Daniel 其實非常好笑，他可以用三種語言講笑話！這陣子，他再也不一個人吃午餐了。他跟我們坐在一起，我們那桌總是最吵的。

passages.title: 其實很溫柔的教練
passages.text: Coach Wang of our basketball team looks scary. He is very tall, he never smiles, and his voice is loud. On my first day, I was so {1} that I wanted to quit. He made us run ten laps every day. If we were late, we had to do fifty push-ups. He never {2} us to rest during practice. But one day, I fell and hurt my ankle. Coach Wang carried me to the nurse's office and stayed with me until my mom came. "I'm hard on you because I want you to get better," he {3} in a soft voice. At that moment, I understood that he was {4} a very kind man. Since then, I have never {5} a practice, and I play better every month.

blanks.why: so scared that…「害怕到…」：嚇得想退出。honest（誠實的）、helpful（有幫助的）、modern（現代的）都不會讓人想退出球隊。
allow + 人 + to + 原形動詞「允許某人做…」：練球時從不讓我們休息。explain、fail、mix 都不能用「人 + to」的句型。
explain「解釋」：教練溫柔地說明為什麼對我們這麼嚴。allowed、failed、mixed 都不能這樣接在引號後面表示「說」。
actually「其實」：原來他其實是個很溫柔的人。ago、else、abroad 都不能放在 was 和 a very kind man 中間。
miss a practice「錯過一次練習」：從那之後一次練習都沒缺席。mixed、allowed、explained 接 a practice 都說不通。

passages.zh: 我們籃球隊的王教練看起來很兇。他非常高，從來不笑，講話也很大聲。我第一天去練球時，怕到想退出。他每天要我們跑十圈，遲到的話就要做五十下伏地挺身。練球時，他從來不讓我們休息。但有一天，我跌倒扭傷了腳踝。王教練把我抱到保健室，一直陪著我，直到媽媽來。「我對你們嚴格，是因為我希望你們變得更好。」他用溫柔的聲音解釋。在那一刻，我明白了他其實是一個非常溫柔的人。從那以後，我一次練習都沒有缺席過，而且每個月都打得更好。
